spec.title: Rooted MAF
spec.target: An exact algorithm returning a minimum-component rooted agreement forest, with a proved O*(c^k) bound for c < 2.3391.
spec.parameter: k = optimum number of components; conversion to cuts and root augmentation must be explicit.
spec.conventions: Ordinary rooted MAF, not acyclic MAF. No added rho leaf by default (baseline v2 Section 2, footnote 2). A leaf partition must have equal rooted restrictions and pairwise vertex-disjoint minimal embeddings in both trees. k counts components; the baseline recursion uses q remaining cuts with initial q=k-1.
